  Exam Date & Time: 30-Nov-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech V Semester - End Semester Examination - Nov / Dec -2024  
  Advanced Machine Learning [IT-5012]  
  Marks: 50                                                                             Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           Compare metric and non-metric proximity measures in classification tasks. Discuss the  
  impact of each on the decision boundaries formed in high-dimensional spaces.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Evaluate the role of feature selection in improving the performance of machine learning  
  models. What techniques would you prioritize in a high-dimensional dataset, and why? (5)  
  
  2)           Analyze how the choice of mutation and crossover parameters in an evolutionary  
  algorithm impacts the model's performance and convergence speed. How would you  
  adjust these parameters for optimizing a predictive model that identifies potential       (5)  
  A)      pandemic outbreaks based on environmental and social factors?  
  
  B)      Given a Random Forest model trained to predict loan defaults, analyze the importance of  
  feature selection by examining the individual feature importance scores. How would the  
  model's accuracy and interpretability change if you were to remove features with low    (5)  
  importance scores?  
  
  3)           Explain how the Naive Bayes algorithm makes predictions based on probability. Why is  
  the assumption of feature independence important in Naive Bayes, and how does this  
  (5)  
  assumption affect the algorithm's performance on different types of datasets?  
  A)  
  B)      Consider an ensemble model that combines Decision Trees, SVMs, and Logistic  
  Regression to predict customer churn. Analyze the trade-offs in terms of computational  
  efficiency, accuracy, and interpretability that might arise from using this ensemble      (5)  
  approach compared to relying on a single model.  
  
  4)           Critically evaluate the limitations of K-means in non-convex and varying-density  
  clusters. How do methods like DBSCAN or Gaussian Mixture Models address these  
  (5)  
  limitations?  
  A)  
  B)      Analyze the impact of gradient vanishing and exploding problems on Back-Propagation  
  in very deep networks.                                                              (5)  
  
  5)           Evaluate techniques like L1 and L2 regularization impact models differently, particularly (5)  
  in binary classification, multi-class classification, and regression tasks?
